With its inception in 1999, Manyavar started its retail journey from 2002 under the name of Vedant Fashions Pvt. Ltd. The brand arrived with 8 stores in 2008 that has now stretched to 600+ stores including 80+ Flagship stores and 13 international stores across 200+ cities in 3 countries – India, UAE, and USA. More than an industry-leader Manyavar is the pioneer in reinventing Men’s Ethnic Wear that has crafted a distinguished image of the respected Indian man. It is backed by a product assortment spanning a rich collection of ethnic and celebration wear. Sherwanis, Kurta Jackets, Indo-westerns, and Accessories form the product bouquet. Each product is a result of the joint efforts and countless work hours put in by handpicked artisans assisted by seamless inter-department coordination, IT-enabled operations, and a formidable sales team. Weddings in India have usually adorned Manyavar. But the brand is not restricted to wedding wear; it has a variety of Celebration Wear. Each is a signature, reflecting intense research, ideas, technology, craftsmanship and benchmarking at every level. A Sherwani is sold every 2 minutes here. Spanning across a large retail space of 1 million sq. ft., Manyavar is still expanding its circle. Mohey, from the house of Manyavar, is the women wear label launched in December 2015. Celebrating womanhood, the launch of Mohey has made it a complete marriage destination. The offerings range from Sarees, Suits, Gowns, Lehengas and Accessories. For exploring exciting career opportunities with us, contact career@manyavar.com

current.employer_linkedin_description: Beyond Snack was born in Kerala, the home of India's most loved banana chips - and built on a simple belief: that the everyday banana chip deserved to be made better than anyone had ever made it.We start with authentic Nendran bananas sourced directly from our farmers, and craft every chip in a women-led facility using a refined, hands-free process built for purity and consistency. The result is the crunch, freshness, and quality that has made us the most loved Indian banana chips brand - and a brand people reach for again and again.We're proud of where we come from and the hands that make us. As we grow, our mission stays the same: to become the most loved snack brand in the world, one honest, delicious bite at a time.

past.employer_linkedin_description: At Cummins, we are on a mission of making people’s lives better by powering a more prosperous world. It starts with what we do and guides us to always innovate products that power our stakeholders – customers, employees, shareholders, communities, partners, dealers, investors, and more. While our products may look different in the years to come, we will always be the makers – the innovators – who continue to reinvent and redesign to create a more sustainable world for all. Cummins India is a leading provider of integrated power solutions for the industrial and automotive sectors, operating through sixteen companies. With 22 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants, assembly, and distribution facilities, and over 10,000 employees in India, the group offers a wide portfolio engaged in designing, manufacturing, distributing, and servicing diesel and natural gas engines and powertrain-related component products. This is the official account of Cummins India where we will be sharing insights, achievements, and the latest news across all our entities and businesses.
